_synthetic: SYNTHETIC COVERAGE SAMPLE. Blank government form, invented taxpayer. Every value is an obvious placeholder (Testcorp, 000-00-0000, 555-0100). No real PII. Its job is to exercise every MAPPED path in 433a.map.json sections 1-3 - it is not a realistic return.
_coverage_notes: 3c_business_type is 'llc' AND 3c_business_type_other_desc carries text. On a real form those contradict (the Other description belongs with the Other box). Both are present here deliberately so the ListOther target is proven to write; it is coverage, not a modelling claim.
Pay periods differ on purpose - taxpayer bi-weekly, spouse monthly - so a copy/paste error between the 4h and 5h blocks shows up in the read-back instead of hiding behind identical values.
Option values deliberately vary in case and padding (' Yes ', 'YES', booleans) to exercise the trim + case-insensitive match.
household_members carries SIX records against five slots: the sixth exists to prove overflow is logged and dropped rather than thrown or silently written.
1a_full_name is 42 chars because that cell carries /MaxLen 45. Longer input is refused by the field, and the fill now stops rather than blanking it.

9b_trust_ein and 9c_trustee_ein are DELIBERATELY ABSENT - the two targets the map assigns them to have maxLength=2 and are the 2-digit prefix half of a split EIN cell (the 7-digit remainder halves are already under _deferred). Neither can hold an EIN, so no value is supplied; see the report to Principal. Every other mapped scalar is exercised.
